newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FAKTO APPLIED FOR BOURSE LISTING.
newsitem.headline: FAKTO APPLIED FOR BOURSE LISTING.

text.p: Tallinn stock exchange said on Wednesday that Estonia's Nissan dealer Fakto had handed in its application to list its shares on the secondary list of the bourse.
"The bourse listing commission will not discuss Fakto's application at the next meeting as we will wait for the results of its share issue," Helo Meigas, bourse director, told Reuters.
Fakto on Monday launched a 4.4 million kroons share issue, which is to end on May 12.
The bourse listing commission will on May 13 discuss Eesti Naitused (Estonian Fairs) and Klementi, Meigas said.
Eesti Naitused, traded on the free market, wants to move to the main list. Clothing company Klementi wants to list its shares on the secondary list of the bourse.
